Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the nursing facility medicaid program trust account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the nursing facility medicaid program trustaccount; adding a new section to chapter 74.46 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 82.71 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The nursing facility medicaid program trust account is createdin the custody of the state treasurer. All funds collected from thetax in RCW 82.71.020 shall be deposited into this account. Only thedirector or the director's designee may authorize expenditures from theaccount. The account is subject to allotment procedures under chapter43.88 RCW, but an appropriation is not required for expenditures.Expenditures from this account shall be used exclusively to increasemedicaid reimbursement rates to the nursing care facilities paid as ofDecember 31, 2004. (2) Funds may not be used to replace existing state expenditurespaid to nursing care facilities for providing services pursuant to themedicaid program.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.71 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The fee collected under RCW 82.71.020 shall be deposited in thenursing facility medicaid program trust account created in section 1 ofthis act.
